opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt and excepted charities; must have at least one year of audited or examined annual accounts; must pass the eligibility quiz.
opportunities.summary: Funding for operating/core costs, capital projects, and specific activity projects. Grants support general running costs, building works or equipment, and defined projects or programmes.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt and excepted charities; must have annual income over £1 million or total project/capital costs over £1 million; must have at least one year of audited or examined accounts; must pass the eligibility quiz.
opportunities.summary: Major Grants support capital or project costs of at least £1 million, or core operating costs for organisations with annual income over £1 million. Applications are made via an Expression of Interest submitted year‑round.
